copy.title: Boltfix Locksmiths — Official Site | Repairs First, Branch Directory
copy.description: Boltfix Locksmiths: the repair-first locksmith network. Eight branches from the Yorkshire coast to Oxford that fix locks other trades would replace — and tell you honestly when replacement really is the answer.
copy.topbar: Fix first. Replace when it's honest. That's the Boltfix rule.
copy.h1: Most 'broken' locks aren't. We prove it daily.
copy.lead: A stiff mortice, a dropped multipoint, a nightlatch that won't catch — nine times out of ten there's a repair in it, at a fraction of replacement cost. Boltfix's eight branches, from Scarborough and Bridlington down through the Black Country to Oxford, are staffed by locksmiths who'd rather fix than fit.
copy.heroNote: {n} branches. Vans stocked with parts, not just replacements.

coverage.heading: Where Boltfix works
coverage.intro: From seaside terraces in Bridlington to college lets in Oxford, each branch runs its own diary on its own number. The areas named are that branch's daily patch.
coverage.areaPattern: Repairs carried out daily in {areas} and across {town}

services.heading: Repair jobs we take on gladly
services.intro: These are the calls where other firms quote a replacement and we usually don't have to.
featured: Mortices, nightlatches, cylinders and rim locks stripped, serviced and brought back to smooth.
Dropped uPVC doors realigned, timber doors eased, hinges packed — the cause fixed, not just the symptom.
Seized espagnolettes and snapped handles repaired with parts, not whole new windows.
Keys extracted and cylinders saved — a snapped key rarely has to mean a new lock.
Non-destructive entry so there's nothing to repair afterwards. Drilling is our last resort, not our first tool.
24/7 cover across all eight towns — emergency doesn't have to mean 'rip it out and start again'.
Forced doors and frames rebuilt and re-secured, working with what survived.

why.heading: Why repair-first wins
points: A gearbox swap costs a fraction of a new multipoint strip. We quote the repair because it's the right call, even though it's the smaller invoice.
Boltfix vans carry gearboxes, springs, cams, followers and cylinders — so a repair verdict becomes a same-visit repair.
Some locks are done. When replacement is genuinely the answer, we say so and show you why — with the worn part in your hand.
Every repair is guaranteed in writing. If it fails again inside the guarantee, the return visit is on us.

cta.heading: Get a repair verdict before you pay for new
cta.sub: Send your local Boltfix branch a photo or a description — they'll tell you straight if it's fixable.

copy.footerBlurb: The official site of Boltfix Locksmiths — eight repair-first branches keeping locks, doors and windows working from the Yorkshire coast to Oxford.
